scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Vidwa Evam Ekal Naari Awas Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow or a single woman and a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh
If applicant is a single woman, age must be 40 years or above
Applicant must not own a private residence or house in a dilapidated condition
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,00,000
Applicant must have at least 02 Biswa of land registered in revenue records for house construction or land made available by the government
Applicant's family must not be receiving government assistance for house construction nor have accommodation approved under any other scheme
Grant can be approved only once in 10 years provided the house has not been destroyed due to a natural disaster
Preference is given to widows and single women whose houses were destroyed due to natural calamities, those with more than 40% disability, and then all other eligible candidates
benefits_summary: An assistance amount of ₹1,50,000 will be given for the construction of the house.
documents_required: Self-attested copies of all mandatory documents
